text.en:
The designation of Director and Assistant Directors of the Philippine Insular Constabulary, is
hereby substituted by that of "Chief and Assistant Chiefs," respectively.
All provisions of existing laws inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby expressly

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 13, 1913.
